source_title: American Diabetes Association: Disease Severity Scale for Diabetes-Related Retinal Disease (2022)
scope: Educational definitions of grading categories; not an interpretation of a particular image and not treatment guidance

definitions.0: The lowest category indicates no visible diabetic retinopathy findings in this grading scale.
definitions.1: The mild category corresponds to small vessel bulges called microaneurysms in the clinical scale.
definitions.2: This is an intermediate non-proliferative category, between mild and severe retinal disease.
definitions.3: The severe non-proliferative category refers to extensive retinal vascular changes without proliferative vessel growth.
definitions.4: The proliferative category involves abnormal new vessels and/or bleeding into the vitreous gel or just in front of the retina.
